name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.CPre.stable
typeText:
∀ (k : Nat) (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) {V : List.{0} Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SafeVars V →
    DisequalityDispersion.Machine.I_ 0 ∉ V →
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUT_ 0 ∉ V →
        ∀ {m m₁ : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},
          DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Agree m m₁ V →
            DisequalityDispersion.Machine.CPre k g m →
              And (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.CPre k g m₁)
                (And (Eq.{1} (m₁ (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.I_ 0)) (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.I_ 0)))
                  (And (Eq.{1} (m₁ (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUT_ 0)) (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUT_ 0)))
                    (Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.arrAt m₁ (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUT_ 0)))
                      (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.arrAt m (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUT_ 0))))))

source.code:
theorem CPre.stable (k : ℕ) (g : GInstance) {V : List ℕ} (hV : SafeVars V) (hI : I_ 0 ∉ V)
    (hO : OUT_ 0 ∉ V) {m m₁ : Mem} (hag : Agree m m₁ V) (h : CPre k g m) :
    CPre k g m₁ ∧ m₁ (I_ 0) = m (I_ 0) ∧ m₁ (OUT_ 0) = m (OUT_ 0) ∧
      arrAt m₁ (m (OUT_ 0)) = arrAt m (m (OUT_ 0)) := by
  obtain ⟨hm, hj, hO1, hO2⟩ := h
  have hhp : 200 ≤ m HP := hm.ctx.2.2
  have hV' : ∀ x, x ∈ V → x < IN := fun x hx => (hV x hx).2.1
  have hI' : m₁ (I_ 0) = m (I_ 0) := hag.var (I_ 0) (lt_hp hhp (by decide)) (by decide) hI
  have hO' : m₁ (OUT_ 0) = m (OUT_ 0) := hag.var (OUT_ 0) (lt_hp hhp (by decide)) (by decide) hO
  refine ⟨⟨hm.of_agree hag hV, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, hI', hO', hag.arrAt hV' _ hO1 hO2⟩
  · rw [hI', hag.var NN (lt_hp hhp (by decide)) (by decide) (fun h => (hV NN h).2.2 (by decide))]; exact hj
  · rw [hO']; exact hO1
  · rw [hO', hag.heap hV' _ hO1 (by omega)]; exact le_trans hO2 hag.2
